english.title: Outside United Kingdom - commit an act of terrorism
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) did outside the United Kingdom an act of terrorism namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), which would, had it been done in the United Kingdom, have constituted the commission of

(A)_[an offence under section 2 of the Explosive Substances Act 1883]_
(B)_[an offence under section 3 of the Explosive Substances Act 1883]_
(C)_[an offence under section 5 of the Explosive Substances Act 1883]_
(D)_[an offence under section 1 of the Biological Weapons Act 1974]_
(E)_[an offence under section 2 of the Chemical Weapons Act 1996]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 62(1) and (2) of the Terrorism Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
